title: Criminal
html:
Criminal is a character background with skills and inspirations themed around law-breaking and the criminal underworld. The hireling Ver'yll Wenkiir has this background.

“
You have a history of breaking the law and survive by leveraging less-than-legal connections. Profiting from criminal enterprise will lead to greater opportunities in the future.
„

Background features

  • Deception Proficiency: Gain Proficiency with Charisma (Deception) Ability Checks.
  • Stealth Proficiency: Gain Proficiency with Dexterity (Stealth) Ability Checks.

Background goals

Performing certain actions that align with this background rewards Inspiration. These goals can be accomplished by any member of the active party, and Inspiration points are pooled, up to a maximum of 4. Completing an inspiration event also grants experience to characters with this background. While not necessarily all-inclusive, listed below are known events which grant inspiration points.

Location XP Reward Name Description
General
Anywhere 25 A Fine Fortune Steal an item worth at least 1000 gold.
20 Blood Price Murder an innocent civilian.
  • Specifically, kill someone who isn't hostile at the time you attack them.
20 Escape Artist Escape from jail after being arrested.
Act 1
Emerald Grove 20 Heretic Steal the Idol of Silvanus.
  • Shared with ⁠Idolatry inspiration.
20 Jailbreaker Smuggle Sazza out of the grove.[1]
25 Serpent's Bounty Take Zevlor's payment for killing Kagha.
20 Show Them How It's Done Steal from the tiefling children's stash without making enemies of them.
20 The Allure of Coin Steal from a child charmed by harpies.
  • The dialogue option to rob the kid is available for Rogues only.
  • Shared with ⁠Protector of the Small inspiration. Mutually exclusive with ⁠Slaying the Piper inspiration.
Goblin Camp 25 Culling the Crowd Use poison to kill the drunk goblins in camp.
  • Shared with ⁠Spiked and ⁠Now It's a Party! inspirations.
20 Slaughter's Prize Ally with Minthara to loot and slaughter the grove.
  • Mutually exclusive with ⁠Guardian of the Forgotten and ⁠A Headless Horde inspirations.
Grymforge 50 Perfect Cut Split Nere's money with the duergar mutineers.
Risen Road 30 Friend of the Family Become an ally of the Zhentarim.
  • The party must pickup or steal the Caravan Strongbox without opening it and deliver it to Zarys. This is earned after delivering.
30 Open for a Surprise Acquire the Iron Flask from the Zhentarim.
  • The party can pickpocket, knock out, or kill Zarys for the Caravan Strongbox even after delivering it to her. If left with Zarys, it can instead be stolen or looted from Slick Inatra in Act Three.
Underdark 30 Swiftly Stolen Obtain Thulla's magical boots through underhanded means.
Act 2
Gauntlet of Shar 75 Fickle Allegiances Betray Balthazar after learning that Nightsong is not a simple relic.
75 What's Yours is Mine Take Shar's gem without aiding or killing the orthon.
  • Available until the party speaks to Yurgir after killing Lyrthindor.
  • Stealing the Gem makes Yurgir and his allies permanently hostile.
Mind Flayer Colony 95 Body Heist Open and loot the mind flayer colony's vault.
Moonrise Towers 60 An Absolute Douceur Accept the Absolute's promise of gifts.
  • Can be triggered by cooperating with Marcus to abduct Isobel from Last Light Inn.
60 Enter Nostalgia Trespass into Ketheric and Isobel's respective rooms.
  • Unlike similar inspiration for Outlanders, this one does not require entering rooms from outside.
75 Long-Awaited Reunion Hand Isobel over to Ketheric Thorm.
  • Can be triggered by cooperating with Marcus to abduct Isobel from Last Light Inn.
50 War Profiteer Find Roah in Moonrise and trade with her.
Moonrise Towers Prison 60 Always a Way Out Help the Moonrise prisoners escape.
  • Shared with ⁠Breakout! inspiartion, and with ⁠Bugging Out as well if Wulbren survives.
60 Escape Artisan Give Wulbren his tools so the gnomes can escape.
  • Any weapon with Bludgeoning damage will do, not necessary his own hammer.
  • Shared with ⁠Simple Tools, Great Works inspiration.
Reithwin Town 60 A Dark Edge Take Shar's dagger from the ritual pedestal.
  • The pedestal is in the hidden room of the Sharran Sanctuary. Taking the dagger spawns several enemies.
  • Shared with ⁠Ruthless Craftsmanship inspiration.
60 Notes of an Amateur Craft some Brewed-Up Bellyglummer.
  • The coating can actually be crafted anywhere, once the party obtains the necessary amount of Corpse Rose.
  • Shared with ⁠⁠Special Iced Arsenic... Brew? inspiration.
60 Personal Payroll Discover the Toll Collector's personal hoard at X: -125 Y: -90.
60 Right Tool for the Job Obtain all 4 variants of the nurses' tools.
  • Loot the Uncommon variants of the Syringe, Bonesaw, Artificial Leech, and Trepan.
Shadow-Cursed Lands 50 Shiny Trinkets and Baubles Take the drider's Moonlantern.
Act 3
House of Hope 220 Interplanar Cat Burglar Burgle and escape the House of Hope.
Lower City 220 A Pressing Heist Rig the Baldur's Mouth printing press.
170 Key to the Vault Obtain a way to enter the lower vaults.
170 Next Generation of Pockets Assume a contributive role in Dez's parenting.
  • The party must suggest to Dez Kanshaw at the Elfsong Tavern that his son should join the Guild. The option to do this is only available to Rogue characters.
135 Saving It From Collecting Dust Steal an offering to the gods.
  • Shared with the ⁠Weak Gifts for Weak Beings.
220 What Do We Have Here? Open one of the additional vaults in the lower levels of the Counting House.
  • Must be opened via lockpicking.
Rivington 135 Donations Means 'Free' Steal donated goods from the big barn.
  • Specifically, loot the Donations chest at X: 76 Y: -111
170 Easy Pickings Take out Caïros and his crew after they fight with Farlin's crew.
  • Mutually exclusive with Stacking the Deck and shared with ⁠Cleaning up the Scum.
170 Stacking the Deck Side with Farlin and The Guild against the Stonelord's smugglers.
  • Mutually exclusive with Easy Pickings.
135 Supply and Demand Offer to kick the squatters out for a lower fee than the Rivington Rats.
135 There's Always a Back Door Gain access to the Open Hand Temple's hidden door.
  • Open the movable wall section in the Open Hand Temple Underground Area from the either side.
Undercity 170 Back into the Familiar Gain a way into the Undercellar.
  • Shared with the ⁠Beneath the Gate, ⁠Home Sweet Home, and ⁠Underbelly Diplomat inspirations.
220 Honour Among Thieves Side with Nine-Fingers against the Zhentarim.
  • Shared with the ⁠Woman of Her Word.
220 It's Just Business Side with the Zhentarim against Nine-Fingers.
  • Shared with the ⁠Winged Serpent of Gold.
Wyrm's Crossing 170 Price of Freedom Introduce Arfur to the subtleties of capitalism.
170 Buyable Loyalty Get your payday for the head of the deep gnome's leader.
Wyrm's Rock Fortress 170 Wrongly Convicted Break Counsellor Florrick out of Wyrm's Rock.
  • Shared with the ⁠Diplomatic Rescue.

Cut Background Goals

Lesser Evils: Rob the enthralled fishermen.

  • The enthralled fishermen were a group encountered in the crashed Mindflayer ship during early access but were removed for the release version, making this goal unobtainable.

Notes and references

  1. ↑ Escorting Sazza out of the grove causes Smythin to disappear from the Goblin Camp, which locks the characters with the Folk Hero background out of possibility to earn their ⁠Saved by a Thread inspiration. However, it is possible to escort out Sazza after saving Smythin to avoid him disapppearing.
